run_recon_multilayer: run the student-teacher reconstruction training loop with hydra config for multilayer knowledge distillation
run_train_model: run one epoch of student model training against a frozen teacher model with loss backprop
run_eval_model: run evaluation of student and teacher model outputs on a dataset and collect stats
run_optimize: run the full optimization loop with configurable SGD or Adam optimizer and learning rate schedule
run_get_active_nodes: run detection of active nodes in a teacher model by checking weight norms across layers
